items.difficulty_reason: Two-direction ZF equivalence; the right-to-left direction needs the recursive construction, an injectivity argument via Trichotomy, and the Hartogs bound. Both cited ingredients are named with no omissions; 35-line proof.

primary.label: author thm environment with its own label thmwochoice (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1202-1204

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the thm: Left-to-right: a well-ordering of the union of A yields a choice function taking least members. Right-to-left: transfinite recursion on a choice function for the nonempty subsets of A builds an injective enumeration of A; Hartogs' lemma shows the recursion must stop, so A is bijective with an ordinal and inherits a well-ordering. (source lines 1206-1240)
